article.title: Powers of superintendence, direction, etc.
article.content:
52APowers of superintendence, direction, etc.

52A. [Powers of superintendence, direction, etc.]—Omitted by Act 7 of 2017, s. 169 (w.e.f. 26-5-2017).
Note: still cross-referred to by section 87(2)(w), which was not consequentially amended.
